listing.name: ZzzOps
listing.long_description: ZzzOps gives Codex a reviewed, prioritized, and resumable project-goal loop. It captures durable work in GitHub Issues, coordinates implementation under reviewed project policy, and keeps human approval at consequential review and release boundaries.

starter_prompts: Review and initialize this project's ZzzOps policy.
Capture a durable project goal with ZzzOps.
Work all available ZzzOps goals until blocked.

availability.rationale: ZzzOps has no operated service, commerce, regional data store, or region-specific functionality; the publisher must still review the portal's current country selection before submission.
